From bb0a2675f72b458e64f47071e8aabdb225a6af4d Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Martin=20Hundeb=C3=B8ll?= <mnhu@prevas.dk>
Date: Wed, 19 Jul 2017 08:17:02 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] net: dsa: mv88e6xxx: Enable CMODE config support for 6390X
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

Commit f39908d3b1c45 ('net: dsa: mv88e6xxx: Set the CMODE for mv88e6390
ports 9 & 10') added support for setting the CMODE for the 6390X family,
but only enabled it for 9290 and 6390 - and left out 6390X.

Fix support for setting the CMODE on 6390X also by assigning
mv88e6390x_port_set_cmode() to the .port_set_cmode function pointer in
mv88e6390x_ops too.

Fixes: f39908d3b1c4 ("net: dsa: mv88e6xxx: Set the CMODE for mv88e6390 ports 9 & 10")
Signed-off-by: Martin Hundebøll <mnhu@prevas.dk>
Reviewed-by: Andrew Lunn <andrew@lunn.ch>
Reviewed-by: Vivien Didelot <vivien.didelot@savoirfairelinux.com>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>

diff --git a/drivers/net/dsa/mv88e6xxx/chip.c b/drivers/net/dsa/mv88e6xxx/chip.c
index 53b088166c28..5bcdd33101b0 100644
--- a/drivers/net/dsa/mv88e6xxx/chip.c
+++ b/drivers/net/dsa/mv88e6xxx/chip.c
@@ -3178,6 +3178,7 @@ static const struct mv88e6xxx_ops mv88e6390x_ops = {
 	.port_set_jumbo_size = mv88e6165_port_set_jumbo_size,
 	.port_egress_rate_limiting = mv88e6097_port_egress_rate_limiting,
 	.port_pause_limit = mv88e6390_port_pause_limit,
+	.port_set_cmode = mv88e6390x_port_set_cmode,
 	.port_disable_learn_limit = mv88e6xxx_port_disable_learn_limit,
 	.port_disable_pri_override = mv88e6xxx_port_disable_pri_override,
 	.stats_snapshot = mv88e6390_g1_stats_snapshot,
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/net/dsa/mv88e6xxx/chip.c`**
   - Added the line `	.port_set_cmode = mv88e6390x_port_set_cmode,` to the `mv88e6390x_ops` structure. This change enables the configuration support for the CMODE (Configuration Mode) for the 6390X family of devices.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification in `chip.c` directly addresses a previously identified limitation in the support for the CMODE configuration for the mv88e6390X family. The patch builds upon the earlier commit (f39908d3b1c4) that added CMODE support for other models (9290 and 6390) but omitted the 6390X. By assigning the `mv88e6390x_port_set_cmode()` function to the `.port_set_cmode` function pointer, this patch ensures that the 6390X now has the same CMODE configuration capabilities as the other models, thereby fixing the oversight from the earlier commit.

Here is the root cause:
The root cause of the bug was the omission of the 6390X family from the CMODE configuration support in the `mv88e6390x_ops` structure. While support was added for other models (9290 and 6390) in a previous commit, the 6390X was not included, leading to a lack of functionality for setting the CMODE on this specific family of devices.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
.port_set_cmode = NULL,
```
Reason:
The `mv88e6390x_ops` structure did not assign a function to the `.port_set_cmode` pointer, which means that attempts to set the CMODE for the 6390X family would not invoke any functionality, resulting in a lack of support for this operation.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
.port_set_cmode = mv88e6390x_port_set_cmode,
```
Reason:
By assigning the `mv88e6390x_port_set_cmode()` function to the `.port_set_cmode` pointer in the `mv88e6390x_ops` structure, the patch enables the functionality to set the CMODE for the 6390X family, thus fixing the omission and ensuring proper operation for this device family.
